# R7

> > R7 is Brazil's leading news portal delivering daily coverage of politics, sports, entertainment, and international news with expert analysis from specialized columnists and journalists.

R7 is a major Brazilian news and entertainment website featuring breaking news, sports journalism, celebrity coverage, and entertainment analysis. The site leverages a network of expert columnists and bloggers covering football, Formula 1, music, cinema, and cultural trends across Brazil and the world.

## Key Topics

- Brazilian Football
- Brasileirão
- Copa do Mundo
- Palmeiras
- Corinthians
- Santos
- Sports Journalism
- Entertainment News
- Celebrity Interviews
- Film Reviews
- Formula 1
- Women's Football
- K-pop & Korean Culture
- Music Industry
- Brazilian Rock

## News & Homepage

- [R7 - Notícias do Dia no Brasil e no Mundo](https://www.r7.com): R7 homepage with breaking news on politics, sports, and entertainment covering Brazil and international events

## Football & Sports Columnists

- [Zé da Zaga: A Coluna de Futebol Que Você Precisa Ler](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/ze-da-zaga): Football column with tactical analysis and behind-the-scenes commentary
- [Blog do Nicola: Jorge Nicola e as Novidades do Futebol](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/blog-do-nicola): Jorge Nicola's football blog with exclusive interviews and market analysis
- [Cosme Rímoli: Notícias de Futebol](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/cosme-rimoli): Football news blog with analysis and transfer coverage
- [Blog do Fabiano Farah: Notícias do Santos FC](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/blog-do-fabiano-farah): Exclusive Santos FC news and behind-the-scenes coverage
- [Blog do Fábio Gomes: Bahia e Vitória](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/blog-do-fabio-gomes): Sports blog covering Bahia and Vitória football teams
- [Gol Delas: Camila Juliotti no Futebol Feminino](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/gol-delas): Women's football blog with news and match analysis
- [História em Campo por Ivan Belmudes](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/historia-em-campo): Football history blog covering dates, titles and curiosities
- [Varal F.C: Camisas de Futebol com Felipe Leme](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/varal-fc): Football shirts blog exploring uniform design and team culture

## Other Sports Coverage

- [Entre Curvas com Renata Garofano: F1 Além da Pista](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/entre-curvas): Formula 1 blog with strategy and behind-the-scenes analysis
- [Cabeça de Chave: Tênis por Ari Peixoto](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/cabeca-de-chave): Tennis blog covering tournaments and player analysis
- [Corrêa com Renata Loures: Dicas e Maratonas](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/corre): Running blog with marathon training tips and fitness advice
- [Jarda por Jarda: Lucas Ferreira analisa a NFL](https://esportes.r7.com/prisma/jarda-por-jarda): NFL analysis blog covering American football and Super Bowl

## Entertainment & Celebrity News

- [Cine R7: Novidades, Críticas de Filmes e Streaming](https://entretenimento.r7.com/prisma/cine-r7): Film reviews, movie news, Oscar coverage and streaming updates
- [Blog da Thaís Sant'Anna: Famosos, Notícias e Curiosidades](https://entretenimento.r7.com/prisma/blog-da-thais-santanna): Celebrity news blog with exclusive interviews and gossip
- [Backstage: Lançamentos e Segredos Musicais com Marcelo de Assis](https://entretenimento.r7.com/prisma/backstage): Music blog with releases, analysis and industry secrets
- [Enigmas do Rock: Histórias do Rock Nacional por Fabricio Mazocco](https://entretenimento.r7.com/prisma/enigmas-do-rock): Brazilian rock history blog with band stories and curiosities
- [Do Meu Tempo: Anos 80, 90 e 2000 com Renato Fontes](https://entretenimento.r7.com/prisma/do-meu-tempo): Nostalgia blog exploring 80s, 90s and 2000s music and culture

## Culture & Lifestyle

- [Aqui na Coreia: Milena e Marina exploram a Hallyu](https://entretenimento.r7.com/prisma/aqui-na-coreia): Korean culture blog covering K-pop, dramas and gastronomy
- [Cinema de Segunda: Terror e Suspense por Lello Lopes](https://entretenimento.r7.com/prisma/cinema-de-segunda): Horror and thriller film review column with recommendations
